title: I'm Freddy Fazbear
blurb: Freddy Fazbear introduces himself, at length, and it is a useful reminder of how far the character has travelled from a 2014 indie game about a security camera. Freddy now has films, plush lines, cereal boxes and a permanent seat in playground folklore, which means his voice carries as much weight as the design does. Fan projects, animations and voice covers have given him a dozen readings over the years, ranging from cheerful mascot to something considerably worse. Long enough to use as an intro clip, and unmistakable within about two words.
origin: An 'I'm Freddy Fazbear' voice clip from the Five Nights at Freddy's fandom.
